desc: The Barrett REC10 LR features an ambidextrous action; high precision barrel; Huxwrx muzzle brake; 15" M-LOK handguard; Radian Raptor LT charging handle; 8 position anti-rotation buffer tube; TriggerTech AR10 adaptable Two Stage trigger; Magpul MOE SL carbine stock and pistol grip. Includes Magpul 20rd magazine.
